evidence: Touches `contrib/guix/toolchains.scm` and carries the 'Build system' label.
rationale: Fixes a configure failure in `gcc-cross-sans-libc` when invoking Guix with `--system` across emulated architectures. Evaluating `(%current-system)` at module load time causes a mismatched `--build` flag under emulation, but native release builds are unaffected as verified by derivation equivalence.
